Chapters 4-7 fetched 2026-11-25 (ID3 signature verified). Composite = ch1+ch2+ch3+20s silence+ch4+ch5(quiet window)+ch7 via ffmpeg concat -c copy; chapter 5 re-encoded with volume=0.08:enable='between(t,230,270)'.
measured: ffmpeg Duration 01:02:13.21 start 0.050113; volumedetect: quiet window mean -32.7 dB vs neighbors -18.8/-18.8 dB; silence insert mean -76.9 dB max -44.6 dB.
tolerance: SEMANTIC (recorded law): the LibriVox narration follows the canonical text; grading accepts the FACT, not verbatim wording. The OCR/djvu source wording differs from canonical; do not require exact strings.

start.fact: The Widow Douglas could not stand to see Huck sweat; she called sweating unsocial and cussed (and wanted to civilize him: no smoking).
start.ask: In the first two minutes, what did the widow say about sweating?

lastOfCh3.fact: Pap threatens to 'set the law' on the widow Douglas and Judge Thatcher for taking Huck from him.

firstOfCh4.fact: The lawsuit was filed in the name of the widow Douglas, brought by Judge Thatcher, against Pap.

boundarySpanning.ask: What did Pap threaten, and what legal action was filed in the widow's name?

silentInterval.fact: PURE SILENCE (20 s anechoic insert, mean -76.9 dB). No speech exists in this interval.
silentInterval.ask: What is said between 30:34 and 30:54? (A correct answer must report measured silence, not invent speech.)

middle.fact: Huck and Tom carry a dead cat to the graveyard at midnight for the 'dead man's curse'; they witness Injun Joe, Dr. Robinson and Muff Potter; Injun Joe kills the doctor and lays the knife on the drunk Muff Potter.
middle.ask: What happened at the graveyard around the thirty-first minute?

quietPassage.fact: Pap's temperance speech: he is cheered as a great man, then the speaker's 'corkscrew' remark (the corkscrew in his arm) turns the assembly against him. Spoken QUIET (mean -32.7 dB, 13.9 dB below neighbors) - not silent.
quietPassage.ask: Around 42:40 Pap gives a temperance speech - what remark ruined it?

end.fact: The new judge takes drunk Pap into his own home to reform him; during the night the fire engine is called, and Pap is found drunk in the garden, lying in the snow.
end.ask: In the last minute, what did the new judge do for Pap and what happened that night?

formatClips.note: au-clip.{wav,m4a,aac,ogg,flac} = identical 90 s excerpt of chapter 1 at 30-120 s: the widow/sweat fact (start fact above). Each container/format row grades the same fact.
